annotation_provenance.published_process: first contributor performed the main annotation; second contributor added annotations and refined existing annotations
annotation_provenance.published_geometry: axis-aligned rectangular bounding boxes at keyframes with linear interpolation between keyframes
annotation_provenance.human_human_agreement_gate: requires separately manifested and independently verified annotation streams; contributor count alone is insufficient

evaluation.timestamp_grid: derive from actual video frame timestamps
evaluation.max_interpolation_gap_ms: must be fixed after inspecting authoritative annotation cadence

conditional_sensitivity_analyses: annotator-as-reference only if independent human annotation streams are actually available and pass the VISUS source-audit gate
claim_limit: No completed VISUS performance or human-human agreement claim until the authoritative data copy and current reuse terms are verified, the source audit passes, and the protocol is frozen with numeric interpolation settings.
